top_jobs.job: When a customer says 'ChatGPT told me your product does X' and it does not, help me find what assistants say about us, where they learned it, and fix it at the source everywhere the fact lives, so I stop selling a promise we cannot keep
top_jobs.metric: share of prompt checks that state a wrong fact about us

top_jobs.job: When buyers ask an assistant for the best product in our category and it names 3 rivals and not us, help me see which questions and sources decide the answer and get our true answers onto them, so I get into the answer where buyers decide
top_jobs.metric: share of buyer prompts where we are named or recommended

top_jobs.job: When everyone says AI search is the future, help me see how many visits, orders and tickets assistants bring us today and whether it is growing, so I give it the time it deserves and not more
top_jobs.metric: sessions and orders from assistants per month, and tickets citing an assistant

top_jobs.job: When an assistant has no information about us or shows a sold-out product at the wrong price, help me make sure bots can read our pages and our price, stock and new products are current, so I do not lose the buyer before they reach us
top_jobs.metric: money pages readable by AI bots, and feed facts that match the site

jobs.job: Write the facts register: every fact buyers ask (price, sizes, materials, care, return window, warranty, shipping, founder story), its true value, and every place it lives
jobs.trigger: once at onboarding, then on every product or policy change
steps: List the 40 facts buyers ask most, from the question matrix and tickets
Write the true value for each from the brain
Crawl the site, feeds and listings for every place each fact appears
Founder signs the true values
Publish a plain facts page on the site from the register
jobs.output: a signed register of 40 facts with every place each lives, and a live facts page

watch.metric: places where a fact differs from the register

jobs.drives: assistants and support saying the same true thing

jobs.job: Run 40 buyer prompts each month across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI answers, and log whether we are named, where, which facts are stated and which sources are cited

inputs.need: 40 buyer prompts from the question matrix and search terms
access to the assistants, by hand or through a GEO tracking tool such as OpenSEO

steps: Run each prompt in each assistant from a clean session, 2 times
Log named or not, position, rivals named, facts stated and links cited
Mark each stated fact right or wrong against the register
A person checks 10 answers by hand
Compare with last month and write 3 lines on what moved
jobs.output: a monthly prompt table with mention share, wrong facts and cited sources
jobs.next: feeds 18-03 (fix at source), 18-09 (citation map) and 18-13 (rival claims)

watch.metric: share of prompts where we are named

jobs.drives: buyers who hear about us from assistants

jobs.job: Fix each wrong fact at its source: find the page the assistant learned it from (our old page, a listing, a review site, a thread), correct or answer it, and recheck in 30 days
jobs.trigger: when the monthly check finds a wrong fact

inputs.need: wrong facts with the links cited
access to edit our pages and listings

steps: For each wrong fact, open the cited links and find the wrong text
Fix it where we own the page; ask the owner or reply publicly where we do not
Log the source, the fix and the date
Rerun the same prompts after 30 days
Mark fixed, partly fixed or still wrong
jobs.output: a fix log per wrong fact with its source and the 30 day recheck

watch.metric: wrong facts still stated after 30 days

jobs.drives: fewer disputes over promises we never made

jobs.job: Find every place a fact differs, such as 60 day returns on the site and 30 on Amazon, and align them all to the register
jobs.trigger: monthly, and after every listing change
steps: Pull each fact from site, feed and listings
Mark every place that differs from the register
Fix the owned places first, then the listings
Log each fix with the date
Rerun the related prompts next month
jobs.output: a diff list with every mismatch fixed or owned

watch.metric: facts that differ across places

jobs.drives: one true answer everywhere

jobs.job: Before a price, policy or shipping change, list every place the old fact lives and update all of them on switch day
jobs.trigger: 2 weeks before any price, policy or shipping change
steps: Pull every place the fact lives from the register
Assign each place to an owner
Change all on switch day, including feeds, listings, FAQ and macros
Check each place the next day
Rerun 5 related prompts after 30 days
jobs.output: a switch-day checklist done, with every place checked the next day

watch.metric: places still showing the old fact after 7 days

jobs.drives: no customer arguments over an old promise

jobs.job: Correct any assistant answer that says our product is safe for a use it is not tested for, such as babies or a medical need, and keep a dated record
jobs.trigger: within 48 hours of finding such an answer

inputs.need: the wrong answer with its sources

steps: Screenshot the answer with date and prompt
Find the cited source and fix or answer it
Add a plain safety line to the product page and facts page
Tell support what to say
Log each step with dates and recheck weekly for 4 weeks
jobs.output: a dated record of the wrong answer, the fixes and the rechecks

watch.metric: answers with an unsafe claim about us

jobs.drives: protected if a customer is hurt or complains

jobs.job: Build the buyer prompt list from the question coverage matrix: tickets, Amazon questions, reviews, site search and Search Console questions

inputs.need: site search terms and question queries

steps: Pull questions from each source for 12 months
Group them into topics and count each
Rewrite the top 40 as a buyer would ask an assistant, with 'best', 'vs' and 'for' forms
Mark each by awareness level and product
Founder removes any prompt we do not want to win
jobs.output: 40 buyer prompts ranked by how often the question is asked

watch.metric: prompts covering the top 20 asked questions

jobs.drives: checks that match what buyers really ask

jobs.job: Fill the blank cells in the coverage matrix: for the 15 most asked questions with no clear answer on our site, add a short answer block on the product page and the FAQ

inputs.need: blank cells ranked by how often asked

steps: Pick 15 questions with no clear answer on the site
Write each answer in 2 to 3 plain sentences with the fact first
Add it to the product page and the FAQ with FAQ markup
Mark the matrix cell filled with the URL
Rerun the related prompts at 30 days
jobs.output: 15 answer blocks live and the matrix updated

watch.metric: prompts where our page is cited for those questions

jobs.drives: win the buyer who is almost ready

jobs.job: Map which sources assistants cite for our top 20 buyer prompts: rival pages, 'best of' lists, Reddit threads, review sites and marketplaces
steps: Collect every cited link from the top 20 prompts
Group by source type and by site
Count how often each site shows
List the 10 sites that shape most answers and whether we appear on each
Compare with last month
jobs.output: a ranked list of the 10 sources that decide answers, with our presence on each

watch.metric: share of top 10 sources that mention us

jobs.drives: effort on the pages that decide the answer

jobs.job: Pitch the 5 'best of' lists and review sites that assistants cite most, with samples and real proof

inputs.need: top cited lists and review sites

steps: Pick 5 lists or sites we are missing from
Find the editor or the way to be reviewed
Send a short pitch with proof and a sample offer
Follow up once after 10 days
Log replies and listings won, and rerun prompts after 60 days
jobs.output: 5 pitches sent and a log of listings won

watch.metric: prompts that cite a list we are on

jobs.drives: named in more buyer answers

jobs.job: Answer the Reddit and forum threads that shape assistant answers about us, honestly, from a named brand account, and fix the cause when the complaint is real

inputs.need: threads cited in answers about us
a person with a named account

steps: List the threads cited for our brand and category prompts
Read each and mark fair, unfair or out of date
Reply once, plainly, as the brand, with what changed
Send real complaints to the product or support owner
Recheck answers after 60 days
jobs.output: replies on the top threads and a list of real problems sent to owners

watch.metric: answers about us that cite a negative thread

jobs.drives: one old thread stops shaping every answer

jobs.job: Publish an honest comparison page for us vs the biggest rival, with a fair table and why we cost more where we do

inputs.need: rival reviews: where they win and fail

steps: List 8 things buyers compare, from prompts and reviews
Fill a fair table for both, with dates and sources
Write who each product is for, including when the rival is the better pick
Explain why we cost more in plain facts
A person checks every rival fact; then publish and rerun 'us vs them' prompts at 60 days
jobs.output: a live comparison page with a checked table

watch.metric: 'us vs rival' prompts that cite our page

jobs.drives: our side in the answer

jobs.job: Watch weekly for a rival being called 'the best value' or repeating a new claim in answers, and respond before our share drops
steps: Run the 10 prompts in the 2 assistants our buyers use most
Note any new claim or label about a rival
Find where it came from: their ads, a list, a press piece
Write our response: a page fix, a pitch or nothing
Log it
jobs.output: a weekly note of rival claims and our response

watch.metric: our mention share on the 10 prompts

jobs.drives: share of recommendations held

jobs.job: Set up a GA4 channel for AI assistants and read visits, orders and landing pages from them each month, next to Google organic

inputs.need: GA4 with a custom channel for chatgpt.com, perplexity.ai, gemini.google.com and others
post-purchase survey with an 'AI assistant' option

steps: Add the assistant channel rule in GA4
Add 'an AI assistant' to the survey question
Each month, pull visits, orders, revenue and top landing pages
Compare growth with Google organic
Write 1 line: how much time AI search deserves this month
jobs.output: a monthly line: visits, orders and growth from assistants vs Google

watch.metric: orders from assistants

jobs.drives: time spent in proportion to what it earns

jobs.job: Count tickets and returns that cite an assistant, name the fact behind each, and give support one true reply per fact
steps: Search tickets for 'ChatGPT', 'AI', 'Gemini', 'the assistant said'
Tag each with the fact it got wrong
Count tickets and refunds per fact
Write one kind reply per fact for support
Send the top fact to 18-03 for a fix at source
jobs.output: a count of 'AI said' tickets by fact, with one reply each

watch.metric: tickets citing an assistant

jobs.drives: fewer refunds from wrong promises

jobs.job: Pick the 1 to 3 assistants our buyers actually use, from survey answers and referral visits
steps: Rank assistants by visits and orders
Add survey mentions
Check the mix fits our buyers' country and device
Pick 1 to 3 to check each month
Drop the rest from the prompt check
jobs.output: a short list of 1 to 3 assistants to watch

watch.metric: share of assistant visits covered by the short list

jobs.drives: time only where buyers are

jobs.job: Check a vendor's AI visibility claim, or our own belief that a change worked, against our prompt checks and visits before paying or giving credit
jobs.trigger: each time a vendor pitches or a win is claimed
steps: List each claim in the pitch or report
Check it against our own prompt history and visits
Look for a control: prompts or pages we did not change
Mark true, false or cannot tell
Write the verdict and 3 questions
jobs.output: a claim check with a verdict and 3 questions

watch.metric: spend on AI visibility tools per assistant order

jobs.drives: no money on noise

jobs.job: Check that assistants can reach our pages (robots rules, bot blocks at the host, content only in JavaScript) and choose which AI bots to let in
jobs.trigger: once, then after any theme, host or security change

inputs.need: server or host logs of AI bot visits
founder choice on training bots vs search bots

steps: Read robots.txt and the host's bot rules
Fetch 10 money pages as the main AI bots and check the text shows
Check product facts are in the first HTML, not loaded later
Founder picks which bots to allow
Fix blocks and recheck in 7 days
jobs.output: a bot access table: each bot allowed or blocked, and 10 pages checked

watch.metric: money pages readable by the main AI bots

jobs.drives: found by assistants at all

jobs.job: Check each week that the product feeds AI shopping reads carry the right price, stock and delivery date, matching the site
steps: Compare feed price, stock and shipping with the site for the top 50 products
Flag every mismatch
Fix at the source feed
Spot check 5 products in an AI shopping answer
Log fixes
jobs.output: a weekly mismatch list with fixes

watch.metric: feed facts that differ from the site

jobs.drives: no lost sale from a stale price or stock

jobs.job: Ship a facts pack on launch day for every new product: facts page entry, product schema, FAQ, marketplace listing and press sheet, and 301 the old product if it replaces one
steps: Add the new product's facts to the register and facts page
Check schema and FAQ on the product page
Update listings and the press sheet
301 the old product and update links to it
Run 5 prompts on the new product at 30 days
jobs.output: a launch facts pack live on day 1

watch.metric: prompts that describe the new product right

jobs.drives: right answers from day one

new_enablers.name: Facts register
new_enablers.what: One list of every fact a buyer or assistant needs (price, sizes, materials, care, return window, warranty, shipping, safety limits, founder story), its true value signed by the founder, and every place it lives: site pages, FAQ, feeds, Amazon and other listings, press kit, old pages. Flags any place that differs.
powers: wrong facts found and fixed at every source
a change list before any price or policy switch

new_enablers.name: Citation map
new_enablers.what: For each buyer prompt, records which pages the assistants cite or lean on: our pages, rival pages, 'best of' lists, Reddit and forum threads, review sites, marketplaces. Counts how often each source shows across prompts and months.
inputs: prompt check results with cited links
powers: which lists and threads decide the answer
where rivals get cited and we do not
which review sites to work on
whether a fix changed the sources
